 Flamengo v Athletico-PR: Brasileirão TV, kick-off, line-ups and officials 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article First up, this Wednesday evening (18) marks the conclusion of Matchday 35 of the 2026 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A with a crucial clash near the top of the table. Kicking off at 8:30 p.m. (Brasília time), the Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro (RJ) hosts Flamengo vs. Athletico-PR.
 Read also: Arthur could extend his Santos contract, but it depends on Neymar
 The clash brings together two teams with important goals in this final stretch of the season. Leading the competition by three points over second-placed Palmeiras, the Rubro-Negro play in front of their home fans seeking a fourth straight win to pave the way toward the national title. Meanwhile, Furacão sit in 5th place with 54 points and are looking to end a four-match winless run to strengthen their hold on a place in next season’s Copa Libertadores.
 OneFootball Videos
 Where can you watch Flamengo vs. Athletico-PR live?
 For supporters and Brazilian football fans who want to follow every moment of the match at the Maracanã, official live coverage will be available on subscription TV and pay-per-view:
 Flamengo at full strength, but suspension risks raise concerns
 Flamengo used the international break to get key players fit again and fine-tune the team under coach Leonardo Jardim. With Varela, Arrascaeta and Plata returning early from their respective national teams, and Alex Sandro , Lucas Paquetá and Danilo rejoining training, the Portuguese coach will have a full-strength squad available. The only confirmed absentees are De la Cruz and Enner Valencia, who remain on international duty.
 The main concern for the Rubro-Negro is the lengthy list of eight players on two yellow cards, including regular starters Arrascaeta, Pedro, Pulgar, Léo Pereira and Alex Sandro, who risk missing the head-to-head clash with Palmeiras next matchday.
 Flamengo’s predicted lineup
 Predicted lineup: Rossi; Varela (Emerson Royal), Léo Ortiz, Léo Pereira and Alex Sandro; Pulgar, Jorginho and Arrascaeta; Carrascal, Samuel Lino and Pedro. 
 Coach: Leonardo Jardim. 
 Confirmed absentees: De la Cruz and Valencia (international duty). 
 One booking away from suspension: Arrascaeta, Pedro, Pulgar, Léo Pereira, Alex Sandro, Bruno Henrique, Luiz Araújo and Vitão. 
 Athletico-PR make tactical changes amid key absences
 On the other side of the pitch, Athletico-PR arrive in Rio de Janeiro under pressure to get back to winning ways after four winless matches. For the challenge at the Maracanã, coach Odair Hellmann faces significant absences across the team: center-back Arthur Dias (who did not return from Brazil duty in time), defender Dantas and forward Viveros (both suspended), defensive midfielder Luiz Gustavo (rested due to muscle discomfort), as well as Terán (contractual issue) and Claudinho (knee injury).
 With those players unavailable, Odair Hellmann is expected to change the team’s formation, bringing Portilla and Zapelli into midfield and deploying Eduardo Vargas as the focal point of the attack.
 Athletico-PR’s predicted lineup
 Predicted lineup: Mycael; Benavídez, Aguirre and Esquivel; Gilberto Moraes, Felipinho (João Cruz), Jadson, Portilla, Zapelli and Mendoza; Vargas. 
 Coach: Odair Hellmann. 
 Confirmed absentees: Arthur Dias (Brazil duty), Dantas and Viveros (suspended), Luiz Gustavo (rested), Terán (contractual issue) and Claudinho (knee injury). 
 One booking away from suspension: Felipinho, Leozinho, Luiz Gustavo, Mycael, Portilla and Zapelli. 
 CBF match officials
 The Brazilian Football Confederation has appointed the match officials and VAR for the final game of the matchday at the Maracanã:
 Referee: Rafael Rodrigo Klein (RS) 
 Assistant referee 1: Guilherme Dias Camilo (MG) 
 Assistant referee 2: Tiago Augusto Kappes Diel (RS) 
 Fourth official: Roger Goulart (RS) 
 Video Assistant Referee (VAR): Caio Max Augusto Vieira (GO) 
 Match details: Flamengo vs. Athletico-PR
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ): Flamengo vs. Athletico-PR
 What time is the Brasileirão match between Flamengo and Athletico-PR?
 The final match of Matchday 35 of the Campeonato Brasileiro will be played this Wednesday, November 18, 2026, with kickoff scheduled for 8:30 p.m. (Brasília time).
 Where can you watch Flamengo vs. Athletico-PR live?
 The clash at the Maracanã Stadium will be broadcast live on subscription TV by sportv and on pay-per-view through Premiere.
 Where do Flamengo and Athletico-PR stand in the table?
 Flamengo lead the Brasileirão by three points over Palmeiras and are seeking a win that would give them the chance to clinch the title next matchday. Athletico-PR, meanwhile, sit in 5th place with 54 points and are battling for a Copa Libertadores spot.
